test_to_read_gcs_formats: test that DataFrame to_csv, to_json, to_parquet, to_excel, and to_markdown support GCS URIs
test_read_gcs_csv_json_parquet: test read_csv, read_json, read_parquet, read_excel reading from GCS URIs via fsspec
test_csv_compression_encoding_gcs: test to_csv with compression and encoding options writing to GCS paths
test_parquet_gcs_new_file: test writing a new Parquet file to a non-existent GCS path using fastparquet engine
test_gcs_not_present_exception: test that reading from a GCS URI raises ImportError when gcsfs is not installed
